title: Overlapping Brasileirão datasets double-count every match in seasons 2012–2019
evidence: database.go:49 loads both Brasileirao_Matches.csv (seasons 2012–2022) and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (Ano 2003–2019) under the same competition label "Brasileirão"; both contain 380 rows for 2019. Live standings for season=2019 return Atletico-MG 96 pts across 38 teams and Flamengo 76 matches (should be Flamengo 90 pts, 20 teams, 38 matches per the spec example on TASK.md:241).
suggestion: De-duplicate the overlapping Brasileirão sources (prefer one canonical series per season, or key matches by date+teams) so standings/team_statistics/competition_statistics are not doubled for 2012–2019.

title: Tests exercise only 3 of 6 tools; standings, head_to_head, competition_statistics and CSV loading are untested
evidence: main_test.go only calls searchMatches, teamStats, players and teamMatch on a 2-row synthetic DB; test_coverage=0.27 in scores.json. standings/head/competitionStats and LoadDatabase/parseDate have no test — the double-count bug in DEF1 would have been caught by a standings test.
suggestion: Add table tests for standings, head_to_head and competition_statistics, and a loader test that asserts season match counts against known values.
